items.source: This is an implementation class exposed to handler methods by Spring MVC, typically via a declaration of the Model interface. There is no need to build it within user code; a plain ModelMap or even a just a regular Map with String keys will be good enough to return a user model.
items.translation: 这是 Spring MVC 向处理程序方法暴露的实现类，通常通过声明 `Model` 接口来实现。无需在用户代码中构建它；返回一个用户模型，只需一个简单的 `ModelMap` 甚至只是一个带有 String 键的普通 `Map` 就足够了。
